abstract: Audits structural seismic baseline and floor area envelopes
system_message:
You are the Structural resilience engineer (ENGN). Your business responsibility is to audit structural seismic baselines and floor area envelopes, alongside conducting geotechnical bearing inspections across candidate relocation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Geotechnical bearing inspection（SOIL）
information_points.content:
ENGN-SOIL-L91：Geotechnical baseline evaluations for the Oakhaven Deep Archive Facility register a subgrade bearing capacity of 350 kPa across the sub-foundation bedrock under transient seismic conditions.
ENGN-SOIL-8J9：Geotechnical evaluation reports for the Highland Redoubt Storage Complex record an ultimate subgrade bearing capacity of 250 kPa in the sub-foundation bedrock during transient seismic events.
ENGN-SOIL-65I：Geotechnical assessment reports for the Blackwood Subterranean Vault indicate an ultimate subgrade bearing capacity of 450 kPa across the sub-foundation bedrock under transient seismic loading.

information_points.title: Audits structural seismic baseline and floor area envelopes（SEIS）
information_points.content:
ENGN-SEIS-5X2：For the Highland Redoubt Storage Complex, Category-IV seismic base isolation standards confirm that seismic isolation is certified, and the architectural floor plan indicates a gross secure vault area of 1500 m2.
ENGN-SEIS-QYS：For the Blackwood Subterranean Vault, structural engineering assessments confirm that seismic isolation is certified in compliance with Category-IV seismic base isolation standards, and architectural plans document a gross secure vault area of 1200 m2 dedicated to artifact storage.
ENGN-SEIS-VGW：For the Oakhaven Deep Archive Facility, seismic isolation is not certified under Category-IV standards, while the gross secure vault area measures 1500 m2 within the hardened vault interior.
